title: 08. Mealtime Champions
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: Lunchtime was coming. Teacher Sheep clapped. Today we'll have a special presentation! Let's each share one way to be a mealtime champion. The Rainbow Class friends' eyes sparkled. What makes a mealtime champion?
Hori jumped up first. A mealtime champion eats all kinds of food! Green vegetables and yellow side dishes. Yum, yum! Pointing to a picture of a plate, Hori spoke proudly.
Next came Toto, bouncing forward with long ears standing tall. A mealtime champion chews well! Munch, munch. Thirty times! Toto pretended to chew.
Then it was Dubu's turn. Dubu wriggled, almost standing up, but stayed put. A mealtime champion sits down to eat! Woof! Dubu gave a big smile.
Suddenly, Kongi sprang up. You're all wrong! A mealtime champion eats really fast! Slurp! All gone in a flash! Kongi pretended to gulp down an acorn.
Bori shook their head. No, we should eat slowly! Rushing can upset your tummy. Fast! Slow! Kongi and Bori wouldn't give in. What makes a mealtime champion?
At last, it was lunchtime! Just as promised, Kongi rushed through the food. Then, cough, cough! A mouthful went down the wrong way, and tears sprang to Kongi's eyes.
Bori did the opposite and ate much too slowly. One spoonful, chew, chew, then more chewing. While everyone else finished, Bori's food was still there, growing cold.

Teacher Sheep hugged Kongi and Bori. Kongi ate too fast and coughed. Bori ate too slowly, and the food got cold. Not too fast and not too slow. A mealtime champion eats at a comfortable pace! Oh, now they understood!

At lunch the next day, everyone ate at a comfortable pace. Kongi slowed down a little, and Bori sped up a little. Yum, yum, at a good pace! Yum, yum, all kinds of food! The Rainbow Class friends all became mealtime champions. Eating well helps you grow.
